newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac - All must be done to launch euro on time.
newsitem.headline: Chirac - All must be done to launch euro on time.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Friday that European countries must do everything, including make sacrifices, to ensure the launch of a single European currency on time.

"There's one point on which we all agree, and that's that we need to do everything, including make sacrifices, so that we can launch this single currency together in the agreed timetable," he told a news conference after a Franco-German summit in the city of Poitiers.
"That could be the point of departure of a new economic period, a new era of development, on the condition that we undertake at the same time the reforms needed in all our countries," he said.

"The European Union today is the region in the world where growth is weakest ... There's something that's not working right," he said. "The European Union is in a strange situation where poverty is on the rise."
He said monetary union was "a vision of the Europe of tomorrow, (and) in the interest of all Europeans".
